rules: Dependencies are minimum prerequisites. Numerical order is the default. Read DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md and feature specifications.

prs.title: Repository and operating contract
prs.scope: Create the monorepo, plans, ADR index, progress log, credential inventory, contribution rules and Engine Room registration record.
prs.acceptance: A new developer can identify every service, planned PR, environment and next action without chat history.
prs.verification: Check documentation links and clean bootstrap; record Engine Room access or pending sync.
prs.rollout: Documentation only; no deployment or new spending.

prs.title: Provider audio and security feasibility
prs.scope: Benchmark candidate generation within approved credits; obtain applicable rights evidence; inspect exact Rave routing; map the full security standard to data flows.
prs.acceptance: Record a supported provider route, measured latency sample, recording tier and explicit unresolved launch gates.
prs.verification: Real provider request and file playback, physical mic capture test, account entitlement and trust-boundary review.
prs.rollout: Keep live generation disabled until G0 evidence passes.

prs.title: Domain contracts and initial schema
prs.scope: Define artist, event, source track, round, wave, allocations, jobs, releases and outbox schemas; add versioned API and event contracts.
prs.acceptance: Tenant relationships and uniqueness constraints exist; migration applies to an empty database and upgrades the prior schema.
prs.verification: Migration integration, schema compatibility and cross-tenant foreign-key negative tests.
prs.rollout: Use additive migrations; rollback app code without dropping collected data.

prs.title: Continuous integration and staging infrastructure
prs.scope: Add build, lint, type, domain-test and security checks; Render deployment configuration; isolated Neon staging and secret references.
prs.acceptance: A commit deploys to the correct staging project with health checks and no production data or secrets in previews.
prs.verification: Deploy smoke test, wrong-environment guard and synthetic fixture inspection.
prs.rollout: Use only authorized resources; disable automatic production rollout during live events.

prs.title: Guest identity accounts and role boundaries
prs.scope: Implement guest sessions, recoverable accounts, artist memberships, display pairing and scoped performer and moderator roles.
prs.acceptance: Tabs share one budget identity; privilege escalation and unauthorized artist access are rejected.
prs.verification: Session lifecycle, CSRF/origin, expired token and role-matrix integration tests.
prs.rollout: Feature flag guest linking; preserve existing guest participation on rollout.

prs.title: Artist album and event preparation
prs.scope: Build artist profile, source-track metadata, core prompt versions, set order, event settings and spending/participation caps.
prs.acceptance: Artist can configure a complete event; invalid prompts or missing assets prevent arming the show.
prs.verification: Setup E2E, validation and cross-artist write tests.
prs.rollout: Configuration versioning; event settings are snapshotted when armed.

prs.title: Durable media ingest and local album cache
prs.scope: Add scoped uploads, object storage, media inspection, waveform metadata and show-laptop download/cache management.
prs.acceptance: Original album stays private unless explicitly published; cached tracks are verified playable before readiness is green.
prs.verification: Interrupted upload, malformed media, checksum, storage access and offline cache tests.
prs.rollout: Keep immutable originals; expire only incomplete uploads under a documented policy.

prs.title: Playback leader queue and round lifecycle
prs.scope: Implement the sole playback leader, ordered queue commands, gapless scheduled boundaries, heartbeat, pause, skip, replay and inserted-track policy.
prs.acceptance: Each eligible source track opens and closes one round; stale leadership suspends generation and local music continues.
prs.verification: Clock, duplicate boundary, two-leader, pause/seek and disconnect integration tests plus audible transition check.
prs.rollout: Expose album-only mode; new epochs fence off stale controllers.

prs.title: Atomic five-point voting
prs.scope: Implement complete allocation replacement, expected revisions, command deduplication, atomic submission vote and zero-support disappearance.
prs.acceptance: No sequence of concurrent requests exceeds five points or accepts votes after the cutoff.
prs.verification: Randomized invariant tests, concurrent tabs and vote-versus-close transaction races.
prs.rollout: Additive counters with reconciliation; disable mutation on invariant alarms.

prs.title: Wave moderation and duplicate handling
prs.scope: Normalize exact duplicates, limit text, enforce core constraints, protect supported phrases from edits and add moderator controls.
prs.acceptance: Unsafe or invalid phrases never reach public rendering; removing a wave returns points consistently.
prs.verification: Injection, Unicode, duplicate, moderated allocation and creator-edit tests.
prs.rollout: Retain audit and undo where appropriate; fail closed for unvalidated new text.

prs.title: Durable realtime subscriptions and recovery
prs.scope: Ship WSS subscriptions, transactional outbox delivery, sequence replay, snapshot fallback and public-screen filtering.
prs.acceptance: An acknowledged vote survives an API restart; reconnects produce an accurate view without duplicate actions.
prs.verification: Crash after commit, duplicate delivery, event gap and unauthorized subscription tests.
prs.rollout: Backpressure and polling fallback; replay schema remains compatible.

prs.title: Audience web app and stable voting controls
prs.scope: Build QR join, live round header, submission, five-point controls, searchable ranked waves, guest profile and pending/error states.
prs.acceptance: A real iPhone and Android browser can join and vote; animation never moves the active input control.
prs.verification: Mobile E2E, keyboard/VoiceOver/TalkBack flow and poor-network recovery.
prs.rollout: Roll out on a private rehearsal event first; core list works without 3D.

prs.title: Production screen and baseline 3D waves
prs.scope: Implement luminous wave bodies, bounded size/rank motion, readable labels, beat envelope input, screen cap and fixed free/buy QR zones.
prs.acceptance: Real votes animate on the screen; sparse and crowded scenes fill the field without overlap or unreadable controls.
prs.verification: Actual display-distance and QR tests; reduced motion, context loss and frame-time benchmark.
prs.rollout: Quality presets and automatic 2D fallback; no simulation in public production events.

prs.title: Generation adapter durable jobs and cost reservation
prs.scope: Add provider capabilities, leased jobs, paid-request lifecycle, budget reservations, request lookup and UNKNOWN reconciliation.
prs.acceptance: Retrying a worker cannot blindly issue a second paid generation; cost caps survive restarts.
prs.verification: Provider fixture tests plus approved live call, timeout-after-acceptance and worker-kill scenarios.
prs.rollout: Live provider feature flag; preserve unknown jobs for operator review.

prs.title: Prompt compiler and boundary dispatch
prs.scope: Freeze ranked snapshots, preserve the core, apply actual provider limits, save inclusion reasons and enqueue one generation.
prs.acceptance: UI and payload share rank order; complete waves fit without truncating the core; each closed round has one generation identity.
prs.verification: Golden payload, Unicode budget, tie, incompatible-wave and close/dispatch integration tests.
prs.rollout: Version prompt compiler; rollback never rewrites a frozen prompt.

prs.title: Validated synchronized releases and downloads
prs.scope: Validate outputs, retain originals, upload durable assets, release ready jobs at boundaries or as-ready, and drain at set end.
prs.acceptance: A published release is playable and downloadable before its notification; late jobs do not delay stage audio.
prs.verification: Partial file, invalid audio, failed upload, duplicate publish and final-set drain tests.
prs.rollout: Publication kill switch and artist hold; assets remain immutable.

prs.title: Listener player and trustworthy play metrics
prs.scope: Add user-initiated audio, seek/resume, range delivery, listened intervals, unique listener and qualified-play metrics.
prs.acceptance: Counts distinguish starts from actual listening; a seek does not qualify a full play or completion.
prs.verification: Media E2E, repeated heartbeat, seek, mute/preview labeling and network recovery.
prs.rollout: Version metric definitions; retain bounded events for aggregate reconciliation.

prs.title: Reactions comments and listening prompts
prs.scope: Add one mutable like/dislike, comment reporting and moderation, and nonblocking completion or greater-than-half navigation prompts.
prs.acceptance: Votes toggle idempotently; OS termination defers feedback to next visit; downloading never requires a rating.
prs.verification: Navigation, exact-half boundary, duplicate reaction, harassment-report and delete-own tests.
prs.rollout: Comments and feedback prompt can be independently disabled.

prs.title: Release email push and preferences
prs.scope: Add verified-email event subscriptions, foreground notifications, supported web push, preferences and delivery outbox.
prs.acceptance: Each opted-in recipient gets at most one logical release notification per channel; email works alongside app push.
prs.verification: Bounce/unsubscribe, retry/deduplication, denied permission and iOS browser-versus-installed tests.
prs.rollout: Provider spending cap, channel kill switch and event digest fallback.

prs.title: Performer feedback dashboard and Play next
prs.scope: Expose real-time popularity with sample size, source lineage, favorites, private preview entry and ordered queue insertion.
prs.acceptance: Play next is one action with undo; repeated requests do not duplicate a track or interrupt the current song.
prs.verification: Two-controller queue conflicts, last-second insertion and unready-asset E2E.
prs.rollout: Only validated cached media is eligible; next album item remains fallback.

prs.title: Private headphone cue and audio diagnostics
prs.scope: Ship phone headphone preview and desktop capability detection, distinct cue/public buses and routing diagnostics.
prs.acceptance: Cue is physically inaudible on the public speaker and excluded from public recording and popularity counts.
prs.verification: Exact OS/browser/device routing test, output change and cue-network-failure rehearsal.
prs.rollout: Default to phone cue; desktop multi-output stays gated until verified.

prs.title: Recoverable recording and hardware tier support
prs.scope: Implement input selection, meters, channel/codec detection, chunk capture, local manifest, resumable upload and tier labels.
prs.acceptance: Capture recovers completed chunks; the declared Rave or alternate interface route is demonstrated or clearly marked unsupported.
prs.verification: Continuous real input test, storage pressure, crash, unplug and upload resume; listen to recovered audio.
prs.rollout: Private recordings by default; room-record fallback is explicit and does not close the clean-mic requirement.

prs.title: Profiles avatars and core leaderboards
prs.scope: Add musical seeded avatars, optional uploads, anonymity, event/weekly/monthly/all-time boards and release-settled credits.
prs.acceptance: Changing votes cannot farm points; public anonymity propagates; failed generations do not count as released contributions.
prs.verification: Ledger recomputation, timezone boundaries, profile sanitization and hide-track tests.
prs.rollout: Rebuildable aggregates and independent leaderboard visibility switch.

prs.title: Artist pages event archives and album commerce
prs.scope: Create public artist/event pages, remote listen mode, explicit remote-voting option, original album purchase links and event track lists.
prs.acceptance: Both QR codes resolve persistently; remote rules are visible; purchase clicks are not counted as sales.
prs.verification: Late-arrival, archived event, external-link safety and remote-admission tests.
prs.rollout: Use existing storefront; native commerce decisions remain deferred to store review.

prs.title: Security privacy and content release review
prs.scope: Complete trust-boundary evidence, authorization matrix, deletion/export, contact consent, recording permissions and incident/takedown controls.
prs.acceptance: No unresolved critical access or secret issue; actual encryption boundaries are recorded without unsupported compliance claims.
prs.verification: Tenant isolation, SSRF/XSS/CSRF, signed asset, deletion and secret-scan gates.
prs.rollout: Close unsafe surfaces; preserve necessary audit records with documented retention.

prs.title: Load monitoring recovery and full show rehearsal
prs.scope: Add dashboards, alerts, event cost telemetry, load profiles, deployment freeze, backup/restore and show checklist.
prs.acceptance: The declared attendance cap, offline playback, generation failure and recording recovery pass on the actual setup.
prs.verification: At least a full set rehearsal; load at twice planned attendance, restore and worker/API restart exercises.
prs.rollout: Admission cap and listen-only degradation; record exact limitations.

prs.title: First production event release gate
prs.scope: Promote the tested commit, verify project-specific production resources, run smoke tests and package operator runbook and evidence.
prs.acceptance: G0–G4 pass; release notes name the supported hardware and enabled features; no first-show promise if gates are red.
prs.verification: Production QR-to-vote-to-generation-to-download-to-cue smoke test with bounded credits.
prs.rollout: Rollback app to last known good commit; no destructive schema downgrade; traditional-show fallback.

prs.title: Cinematic wave rendering and visual identity
prs.scope: Refine custom deformation, lighting, depth, filaments, transitions, event palettes and audio-driven independent motion.
prs.acceptance: Scene meets the desired living 3D aesthetic without losing readability or stable controls.
prs.verification: Visual review on show display and representative phones; long thermal/performance session.
prs.rollout: Ship graded presets and visual feature flags.

prs.title: Dense crowds adaptive layout and discovery
prs.scope: Support high submission volume, overflow representation, rank-stable discovery, venue presets and screen-size controls.
prs.acceptance: All eligible waves remain discoverable while only the configured number have readable labels.
prs.verification: 10/100/1000-wave scenarios, rapid rank churn, search access and projection-distance tests.
prs.rollout: Participation cap remains distinct from visual capacity.

prs.title: Advanced recognition and leaderboard analytics
prs.scope: Add release receipts, Late breakout and Early spark criteria, per-round averages and anti-farming analysis.
prs.acceptance: Every award is reproducible from stored evidence and does not alter voting weight.
prs.verification: Ledger replay, duplicate author, late-wave and minimum-sample tests.
prs.rollout: Version awards; preserve historic rule version.

prs.title: Fan collections following and return journeys
prs.scope: Build follows, personal favorites, event collections, consented future-event reminders and shareable contribution receipts.
prs.acceptance: Fans can return directly to their artist and contributions without exposing private identity.
prs.verification: Account link/recovery, consent, unfollow and private/public sharing tests.
prs.rollout: Default marketing off; notifications obey saved preferences.

prs.title: Native iOS and Android foundation
prs.scope: Add Expo applications, secure credential storage, shared domain/contracts, build signing and deep-link foundations.
prs.acceptance: Installable internal builds on both platforms authenticate against staging with no embedded secrets.
prs.verification: Real-device install, login/logout, token expiry and contract parity checks.
prs.rollout: Internal distribution first; store credentials remain project-specific.

prs.title: Native voting profiles and optimized visualization
prs.scope: Implement Live, Tracks, Leaders and You with mobile wave renderer and accessible stable controls.
prs.acceptance: Native budgets and rankings match web; thermal limits degrade effects without disabling play.
prs.verification: iOS/Android parity E2E, VoiceOver/TalkBack, reconnect and device GPU tests.
prs.rollout: Keep list fallback; feature parity tracked per platform.

prs.title: Native audio offline downloads and media sessions
prs.scope: Add background playback, explicit downloads, local file management, lock-screen controls and interruption handling.
prs.acceptance: Downloaded public tracks play offline; phone calls and output changes preserve recoverable playback state.
prs.verification: Real devices, screen lock, airplane mode, storage full, Bluetooth change and app restart.
prs.rollout: Quota-managed local storage; private media is not accidentally made public.

prs.title: Native notifications and event deep links
prs.scope: Integrate APNs/FCM or approved Expo push route, token lifecycle and release/account deep links.
prs.acceptance: Release taps resolve the correct public track and preferences suppress unwanted notices.
prs.verification: Foreground/background/terminated app tests, invalid token receipts and duplicate delivery.
prs.rollout: Push kill switch; email and foreground feed remain independent.

prs.title: Store readiness privacy and user content review
prs.scope: Complete store metadata, account deletion, reporting/blocking, privacy declarations, age policy and regional purchase-link decisions.
prs.acceptance: Both builds satisfy documented current submission requirements with usable reviewer access.
prs.verification: Policy checklist against official sources plus real-device release builds and accessibility review.
prs.rollout: Staged release after actual approval; approval timing is external.

prs.title: Advanced recording exports and live performance releases
prs.scope: Complete multichannel support on verified hardware, alignment/export, performer permissions and separate rap-version publishing; decide on companion app only if tests require it.
prs.acceptance: Backing and vocal channels are correctly identified where available; public release requires the distinct recording workflow.
prs.verification: Long recording/drift/recovery tests, consent revocation before publish and manifest import.
prs.rollout: Private originals retained; publish new versions rather than overwriting raw takes.

prs.title: Artist onboarding quotas and cost administration
prs.scope: Add self-service artist configuration, resource quotas, usage statements and administrator cost controls; billing integration remains optional until business terms are chosen.
prs.acceptance: Multiple artists remain isolated and one event cannot exhaust another artist's authorized budget.
prs.verification: Multi-tenant concurrency, cap enforcement and cost reconciliation tests.
prs.rollout: No paid audience voting; newly billable services require spending approval.

prs.title: Event album export and distributor handoff
prs.scope: Create sequenced audio/artwork/credits packages with rights and AI metadata, and a distributor adapter only if an authorized API is confirmed.
prs.acceptance: An event can become a reviewable distribution package; DSP delivery is never described as instantaneous.
prs.verification: Export validation, checksum/metadata review and a sandbox integration if available.
prs.rollout: Manual export is supported; no automatic external submission without authorization.

prs.title: Horizontal scale and high attendance validation
prs.scope: Add shared fanout coordination when needed, tune database access and certify larger declared event capacities.
prs.acceptance: Multiple API instances cannot diverge votes or leader state; 1000-participant target is enabled only after measured success.
prs.verification: Cross-instance reconnect, burst load, noisy-artist isolation and database saturation tests.
prs.rollout: Canary rollout and admission caps; broker is not sole vote storage.

prs.title: Disaster recovery and provider continuity
prs.scope: Automate reconciliation and restore drills; add a second provider only if approved for rights, cost and sound; document key rotation and vendor outage handling.
prs.acceptance: An operator can recover published assets and state; provider uncertainty cannot trigger duplicate charges.
prs.verification: Isolated disaster restore, credential rotation and primary-provider outage exercise.
prs.rollout: Failover off by default until approved and rehearsed.

prs.title: Complete production V1 acceptance
prs.scope: Run full requirements traceability, real show acceptance, native/store deployment evidence and post-event operational review.
prs.acceptance: All V1 requirements are implemented or expressly documented as hardware/provider-dependent limitations accepted for a supported configuration.
prs.verification: Cross-platform and live-hardware acceptance matrix, production smoke, security and restore evidence.
prs.rollout: Tag release, retain rollback plan and move unresolved optional integrations into explicit later work.

prs.title: DJ round and performance segment model
prs.scope: Define performer-controlled rounds independently of file ends, eligible source anchors, minimum participation windows and one-time close commands.
prs.acceptance: Loops, crossfades and multiple source tracks have an explicit core prompt; only one close triggers generation.
prs.verification: State-machine tests with loop, seek, early close, replay and stale commands.
prs.rollout: Feature flag DJ event type; album-release V1 semantics remain versioned.

prs.title: DJ controls and boundary gestures
prs.scope: Add Open round, Close and generate, Hold and Cancel controls, performer shortcuts and optional MIDI mappings.
prs.acceptance: The DJ can close once during a transition without accidental repeated charges; crowd sees clear round state.
prs.verification: Rapid repeated controls, MIDI bounce, accidental tap undo rules and lost-controller tests.
prs.rollout: Hardware controls require deliberate mapping and an emergency disable.

prs.title: External decks timing and audio bridges
prs.scope: Implement one documented DJ integration selected from actual available SDK, MIDI, OSC or playback metadata; add manual bridge where no supported integration exists.
prs.acceptance: Metadata, beat clock and performer boundaries have explicit authority and licensing; no claim of universal DJ-software support.
prs.verification: Actual target software/hardware and reconnect tests; verify control and audio clocks separately.
prs.rollout: Manual boundary mode always available; integration-specific feature flag.

prs.title: Mix-aware prompt and generation policies
prs.scope: Support selected source cores, DJ tempo/key constraints, bounded mixtures and optional preapproved reference audio.
prs.acceptance: Crowd additions preserve DJ locks; changing the mix does not mutate already submitted prompts.
prs.verification: Prompt lineage, conflicting keys, multi-source rights and rapid-transition tests.
prs.rollout: Reference audio and optional provider features remain gated by entitlement.

prs.title: Two-deck preview and performance queue
prs.scope: Add preview decks, next-slot placement, cue markers and approved crossfade controls with separate public and cue buses.
prs.acceptance: The DJ can audition and bring a crowd output into the mix without leaking preview or duplicating a queue item.
prs.verification: Real mixer/interface routing, last-second transitions and missing-asset fallback rehearsal.
prs.rollout: Keep original deck playback authoritative; instant live synthesis is not promised.

prs.title: DJ crowd display and release timing
prs.scope: Adapt display progress for open-ended rounds, DJ-triggered countdowns, stage transitions and ready-result release controls.
prs.acceptance: The audience always knows whether voting is open; a loop or crossfade cannot silently close the round.
prs.verification: Variable-length rounds, prolonged holds, countdown cancellation and result-ready E2E.
prs.rollout: Clear non-countdown state when the DJ has not set a deadline.

prs.title: DJ recording and set lineage
prs.scope: Capture supported mixer or interface outputs, preserve cue isolation, segment the set and maintain source and contributor lineage.
prs.acceptance: Recorded set and separate generations have correct rights and timestamps; unsupported deck signals are labeled.
prs.verification: Long-set drift, recording recovery, consent and export inspection.
prs.rollout: Private capture until explicit set-release workflow completes.

prs.title: DJ production release and field acceptance
prs.scope: Run actual DJ session with unpredictable transitions, crowd participation, network failure and provider slowdown.
prs.acceptance: DJ version passes independent operational gates without regressing album V1.
prs.verification: Hardware-in-the-loop rehearsal, cross-platform regression and event recovery run.
prs.rollout: Release as V2 with supported integration matrix and rollback.

prs.title: Isolated demonstration sessions
prs.scope: Add a separate demo event namespace with keyboard-first single-user operation and disposable state.
prs.acceptance: Demo data cannot enter real events, public leaderboards, artist analytics or notifications.
prs.verification: Isolation tests and demo reset E2E.
prs.rollout: No production override tokens; explicit Demo label.

prs.title: Presentation controls and simulated crowd
prs.scope: Provide seeded crowd playback, pause, scrub, reveal, reset and venue visualization presets.
prs.acceptance: Presenters can explain the game reproducibly; simulated votes and recorded audio are unmistakably identified.
prs.verification: Deterministic replay, reset and side-effect suppression tests.
prs.rollout: Simulation mode never calls a paid provider.

prs.title: Optional real-generation demonstration
prs.scope: Add an explicit live-provider option with its own event budget and a clearly marked prerecorded fallback.
prs.acceptance: Real and prerecorded results cannot be confused; no email, publication or leader credit occurs implicitly.
prs.verification: Budget, provider failure and output-label tests.
prs.rollout: Real generation requires configured approved credits and a deliberate mode switch.

prs.title: Demonstration packaging and regression gate
prs.scope: Create presenter instructions, sample assets with rights, reset scripts and an isolated deploy configuration.
prs.acceptance: A new presenter can run offline simulation or explicitly enabled real generation without production access.
prs.verification: Clean-start walkthrough, offline mode and production regression tests.
prs.rollout: Ship secondarily after production V1; maintain separate credentials and metrics.
